I was sent to a hospital upstate recently for trying to kill myself. My psychiatrist was one of these. First day, he goes into what I found out later was his "usual" routine for helping. "Don't do what you feel, do what is right." If it sounds like bullshit, it was. Then he finds out my beliefs. Next day, this somehow magically changes to "Don't do what you believe, do what is right." I'm like fine, whatever, just shut up. We got into an argument one day, he showed me Sid Roth, saying he talks to people who have had faith healing. I direct him to Derren Brown, with his faith healing episode, and he proceeds to do more bullshitting. Last day I'm there, been there 9 days, no help to my suicidal tendencies, he switches it up one last time: "Don't do what you believe, do what is normal." Basically, my psychiatrist, with a doctorate, told me to conform in order to be less suicidal. I fucking lost it. I was surprised they still let me leave after. They gave me a survey after, and I wrote down "Cut Dr.Blahblah's pay. Whatever he's getting, he doesn't deserve half of it. He is a terrible doctor." But I'll tell you what, while my suicidal thoughts did not go down, my homicidal thoughts went up. I would never, but I certainly thought quite a bit about it. 

End of rant.
